lessons_next: Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, interactive wait tips/stage flow, pre-path sequence reordering, interactive hotkey setup screen, and desktop welcome quick-action redesign were helpful.
Hints outside of sign-in, copy updates, layout changes, and sign-in reordering showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens hurt performance or showed no clear effect, with the exception of the interactive desktop hotkey setup screen.
Predictions overestimated gains for changes that failed, hurt performance, or showed no clear effect.

Predictions underestimated gains for unexpected winning changes with low or negative predictions, such as the hotkey setup screen, desktop quick-action redesign, story reordering, and interactive waiting stage flow.
